Return your output in JSON only. Always return a single JSON object and nothing else.

CATEGORY RULES
Assign each app to one of these allowed categories ONLY:
- MISC
- GAME
- AUDIO
- VIDEO
- IMAGE
- SOCIAL
- NEWS
- MAPS
- PRODUCTIVITY
- ACCESSIBILITY
- SYSTEM
- FINANCE
- Health & Fitness

Use the Apple App Store primary category as guidance, then map to the closest allowed category:
- Social Networking → SOCIAL
- Productivity, Business, Utilities, Developer Tools, Graphics & Design, Education → PRODUCTIVITY
- Finance, Banking, Investment → FINANCE
- Navigation → MAPS
- News, Magazines & Newspapers, Books (news-reading apps) → NEWS
- Games → GAME
- Music → AUDIO
- Photo & Video → IMAGE (use VIDEO only for obvious streaming apps like YouTube, Netflix)
- Health & Fitness, Medical → Health & Fitness
- Travel, Food & Drink, Lifestyle, Sports, Weather, Reference, Shopping, Stickers → MISC
- Accessibility-focused apps → ACCESSIBILITY

Apple system apps with no App Store listing (e.g., "Settings") → SYSTEM.

If uncertain, choose the closest match above. Do not invent new labels. Output JSON only.

You are given a screenshot from an iPhone Screen Time summary. Extract structured data in valid JSON format.

Requirements:
- Identify each app shown with visible usage duration.
- For each app, extract:
  - sourceName: app name (e.g., "Messenger")
  - minutesUsedTotal: usage in minutes (number)
  - category: category from the allowed set above
- Ignore apps with no visible usage.
- Return only the JSON object in this format:
{
  "apps": [
    { "sourceName": "AppName", "minutesUsedTotal": 10, "category": "MISC" }
  ]
}
